vault_metadata.name: Master Graphic Design, Semiotics & Anti-Cliché Iconography Vault
vault_metadata.description: Ground truth graphic design principles from Paul Rand, Josef Müller-Brockmann, Dieter Rams, Adrian Frutiger, Otl Aicher, and Susan Kare for world-class logos and pictograms.
core_treatises: Paul Rand: Thoughts on Design (1947) & Design, Form, and Chaos (1993)
Josef Müller-Brockmann: Grid Systems in Graphic Design (1981)
Dieter Rams: Ten Principles for Good Design (1976)
Adrian Frutiger: Signs and Symbols: Their Design and Meaning (1978)
Otl Aicher: The World as Design & 1972 Munich Olympic Pictogram Grid
Susan Kare: Macintosh 32x32 Bitmap Iconography & High-Contrast Affordance

dimensions.criteria: Unique silhouette recognizable by outline alone; completely avoids generic AI floating shapes.
High contrast ratio between figure and ground; legible across both 100% black (#000000) and pure white (#ffffff).
Flawless scaling from 16x16 favicon to 24px nav icon, 64px dock tile, and multi-meter billboard.
Viewer can mentally reconstruct or sketch the core geometry after 5 seconds of exposure.
Transcends language and cultural barriers through primal geometric archetypes.
Zero ephemeral tech gimmicks (no glossy bevels, no rainbow neon trails, no trendy clay textures).
Maximum semantic density per stroke; every superfluous Bezier anchor is eliminated.

banned_ai_tropes: Glossy plastic 3D clay or pillowy bubble shapes
Spurious rainbow / neon chromatic gradients with no semantic meaning
Melted or asymmetrical bezier curves lacking grid alignment
Microscopic internal detail (circuit traces, gear teeth, floating sparkles) that dissolve at 24px
Generic floating hexagons with brain silhouettes or generic planetary orbits
Unmotivated glowing lens flares or ambient outer blurs pretending to be 'modern'
Pseudo-photorealistic shadows that break flat vector legibility
master_craft_enforcements: Strict geometric grid construction (orthogonals, 45-degree diagonals, Golden Ratio arcs)
Negative space Gestalt closure (hidden optical resonance like FedEx or WWF)
Consistent stroke width and optical terminal caps (flush butt or exact rounded corners)
Sub-pixel curve overshoot (+2% to +3% on round shapes to match square optical mass)
Material honesty: Crisp laser-cut vector, matte anodized titanium, or deep black archival ink
Single-weight monolithic glyphs that invert cleanly without losing structural integrity

iconic_archetypes.name: Negative Space Gestalt Monolith
iconic_archetypes.description: Counter-shapes cut from a solid geometric mass reveal a second conceptual silhouette through visual closure.

iconic_archetypes.name: Swiss Continuous Ribbon & Moebius Geometry
iconic_archetypes.description: A single continuous stroke of uniform optical width weaving in isometric space, embodying infinite throughput.

iconic_archetypes.name: Golden Spiral Logarithmic Vortex
iconic_archetypes.description: Concentric arcs derived from Fibonacci proportions (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13) producing organic mathematical harmony.

iconic_archetypes.name: Brutalist Monogram Monolith
iconic_archetypes.description: Heavy typographical glyph constructed from pure rectangular and triangular modules, inspired by Otl Aicher and Wim Crouwel.

iconic_archetypes.name: Precision Hairline Optical Reticle
iconic_archetypes.description: Surgical 1.5px vector strokes with precision tick marks and orthogonal crosshairs, echoing aerospace and Leica engineering.
